source.test: ConfigManager.init — xbox_broadcast_alt_password migrates independently of remote_api_token

notes: No top-level remote_api_token key at all (e.g. a config whose owner token was already migrated in an earlier run). Source lines 84-99 run the per-server password migration as a wholly separate loop after the token check, so this proves the two migrations don't depend on each other -- the password still migrates on its own.
